title: Fixed Cavity Resonance with Free Mirror Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Fixing the defect cavity layer at half-wave optical thickness (250 nm ±12 nm) while allowing mirror layers to optimize freely will recover or exceed the previous best target score of 0.7111 by preventing the optimizer from collapsing the cavity into uniform mirror periods.
design_principle: Decouple resonant transmission condition from Bragg reflection condition by hard-constraining the cavity thickness while permitting full optimization of surrounding DBR mirror pairs.
proposed_topology: exactly 20 finite layers from the incident side: HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica

manufacturing_considerations: Cavity thickness tolerance ±12 nm represents fabrication-aware constraint
Alternating HfO2/SiO2 compatible with electron beam evaporation or ion-assisted deposition
theory_basis: Defect cavity in DBR stack creates transmission band within reflection stopband
Half-wave optical thickness at cavity produces resonant transmission peak
Quarter-wave mirror pairs maximize reflection bandwidth
expected_advantages: Prevents cavity collapse into mirror periodicity
Maintains physical resonance condition throughout optimization
Allows mirror layers to adapt around fixed resonance
known_risks: Fixed cavity may limit optimizer flexibility if 250 nm is not optimal
Score may not recover to 0.7111 if cavity position rather than thickness is limiting factor
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 20-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 20-layer alternating dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Material sequence: SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2. Layer 10 (SiO2 cavity) must be initialized at 250.0 nm with hard bounds [238.0, 262.0] nm. Layers 0-9 and 11-19 are free optimization variables with bounds [50.0, 450.0] nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer. Target: maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band, maximize reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to fix cavity layer at half-wave resonance (250 nm ±12 nm) to prevent optimizer from collapsing cavity into uniform mirror periods. Addresses score regression from 0.7111 to 0.6601 by enforcing physical resonance condition.
